description_excerpt: ABOUT YOUR ROLE The Senior Sourcing Developer is responsible for managing day-to-day sourcing development and supplier execution activities for Altra Apparel. Working closely with Product Creation teams, Product Supply partners and manufacturing suppliers, the role ensures products are developed and commercialized in alignment with brand expectations, seasonal priorities and sourcing strategies.
